# `debug`

Run environment + module import diagnostics for SLURM job scripts

- Wrapper: [`job_debug.sh`](https://github.com/dr-michael-haley/imcanalysis/blob/main/SLURM_scripts/job_debug.sh)

## Inputs

- SLURM_scripts/job_*.sh metadata and SLURM_scripts/env_imports.yaml

## Outputs

- imc_env_test_%j.out
- outputs/023_Environment_Diagnostics/<run_id>/ stage report under sbt

## Configuration

- none

## Run

From the dataset directory containing `config.yaml`:

```bash
pl debug
```
